$comment: v6.3 D09 reader refusal matrix: what each old entry point does with each new format. 'current' is tested on this tree (tests/contracts/test_v63_d09.py); 'release_0_11_0' was measured on the 0.11.0 release tree (docs/dev/v6.3/refusal-matrix.md). A row that accepts or exposes is a release blocker until a real refusal exists.

rows.evidence: status invalid (schema.const on format and bundle_version)
status ok, exit 0: a file without inputs passes
rows.note: does not misread a field (it finds no inputs), but reports a non-artifact as dependency-consistent; refuse non-envelopes before any release that ships v2 bundles
rows.resolution: documented as intended: the docstring says an artifact with no inputs, or '{}', is consistent but not thereby allowed; it reads no field of the context. Closing this row needs a non-author review (G-ENFORCE step 2)

rows.evidence: reads the correction keys under measurement:correction-keys-v1, which it implements; refuses an upstream artifact with an unknown capability (semantics.upstream_unknown_capability)
rows.note: 0.11.0 reads the same keys with the same meaning (R4) and never checks capabilities; a 0.11.0 reader that meets a later capability would still read it: the release column stays 'exposes' (already released)

rows.evidence: knows the keys under the capability
rows.note: the 0.11.0 reader rejects the spec with contract.unknown_capability

rows.evidence: the v2 digest rule is the 1.0.0 one (D10)
rows.note: 0.11.0 digests a v2 bundle as an execution bundle, so its attestation never binds (attestation.bundle_changed)
